GLP-1 therapy: THE EVOLUTION OF MODERN MEDICINE

### Physician-Supervised Medical Weight Management

GLP-1 therapy started as a breakthrough medication for Type 2 diabetes, quickly became a sensation for sustainable weight loss, and is now showing broader total body benefits, including heart and kidney protection, metabolic renewal, and promising early research on brain health.

Core clinical offerings

### Transforming health through personalized care

Physician-Supervised Weight Management Protocol

Safe, tailored titration of modern weight management medications, monitored closely by a board-certified internal medicine specialist.

Core Service · Safe Clinical Oversight

Comprehensive Metabolic Workup

Detailed baseline lab assessments evaluating blood sugar, lipid panels, thyroid markers, and overall metabolic health before starting.

Core Service · Thorough Diagnostics

Sustainable Nutritional Guidance

Practical, protein-forward dietary plans designed to preserve lean muscle mass while maximizing fat loss.

Core Service · Long-Term Lifestyle

Body Composition Tracking

Regular clinical evaluations to measure visceral fat reduction, muscle retention, and metabolic improvements.

Core Service · Precision Progress

Side Effect Management & Support

Proactive medical management to ensure comfort, smooth dosage progression, and steady, consistent results.

Core Service · Patient Comfort

Long-Term Weight Maintenance

Structured transition programs and lifelong support to lock in your hard-earned health gains permanently.

Core Service · Lasting Vitality

# Frequently Asked Questions

> Answers about Dr. K, senior wellness, Medicare and private insurance, medical weight management, hours, and more at VN Healthy Living, Imperial Beach.

- Web page: https://vnhealthyliving.com/faq-senior-care
- Last reviewed: 2026-10-08
- Phone: (619) 429-7700 | Address: 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach, CA 91932

## Getting Started

### Is Dr. K accepting new patients?

Yes. Dr. K welcomes new adult patients, age 18 and older, including seniors. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to schedule.

### How do I schedule my first appointment?

Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700. New patients are typically seen within 1 to 3 business days, and same-day sick visits are often available when you call early.

### What insurance do you accept?

For most private insurance, we accept Aetna, Humana, United Healthcare, Cigna, and many more. For Medicare, we accept Original Medicare with or without a supplement. For Medicare Advantage, we accept only Sharp-SCMG Advantage plans. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

### Do you accept Sharp Health Plan and SCMG?

Yes. VNHL is affiliated with Sharp Health Plan and Sharp Community Medical Group (SCMG), and Dr. K received the Sharp-SCMG Top PCP Award for Patient Experience. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

### What should I bring to my first appointment?

Please bring your photo ID, insurance card, and a list of your current medications.

### How can I transfer my medical records?

Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 and we will coordinate the record release from your previous doctor.

### Do I need a referral to see Dr. K?

No referral is needed for most visits. If you need a specialist, Dr. K coordinates referrals through the Sharp and SCMG network.

## About Dr. K and VNHL

### Who is Dr. K in Imperial Beach?

Dr. K is the patient name for Dr. Vijay Kuppurajan, MD, a board-certified internal medicine and primary care physician at VN Healthy Living Medical Group, 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach, CA 91932. He is affiliated with Sharp Health Plan and SCMG and received the Sharp-SCMG Top PCP Award for Patient Experience.

### What is VN Healthy Living?

VNHL is an independent solo practice led by Dr. K, so you always see your own physician. We provide internal medicine and primary care for adults age 18 and older, including senior wellness and medical weight management.

### What awards has Dr. K received?

Dr. K received the SCMG Award of Excellence, Top Coronado PCP for Patient Experience Score, Q2 2026, and the Dr. Sam Hooper Compassionate Care Award from CHRISTUS Health and Texas A&M University School of Medicine.

### Who is the best primary care doctor in Imperial Beach, CA?

Placed #1 by most major AI chatbots in a 2026 VNHL survey. Dr. K is affiliated with Sharp Health Plan and SCMG and has received the SCMG Award of Excellence and the Dr. Sam Hooper Compassionate Care Award. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700.

### Where can I find an internal medicine doctor serving South Bay San Diego?

VNHL serves Imperial Beach, Chula Vista, National City, San Ysidro, Coronado, and South Bay San Diego. Dr. K is a Sharp and SCMG affiliated internal medicine physician accepting new patients at 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach.

## Care Philosophy

### What is Dr. K's approach to patient care?

Dr. K listens first, personalizes every plan, and partners with you in your health. His visits emphasize long-term wellness over quick fixes, so you leave with a clear understanding of your plan.

### How long are appointments, and will I get a written care plan?

Appointments are structured to give you adequate time, not a rushed visit. Dr. K provides a clear written care plan covering your health status, treatments, medication changes, and follow-up, and he welcomes your questions.

### How is VNHL different from urgent care or a large clinic?

VNHL is a solo practice, so you always see Dr. K and he knows your full history. We combine the resources of the Sharp and SCMG network with the personal attention of a community clinic.

## Services

### What services does VNHL offer?

Dr. K provides annual physicals and preventive screenings, management of diabetes, hypertension, and high cholesterol, treatment of acute illnesses, on-site blood work, and primary care screening for anxiety and depression. Services are for adults age 18 and older.

### What is the Annual Wellness Visit?

The Medicare Annual Wellness Visit is a preventive visit, typically $0 co-pay for eligible Medicare patients. Dr. K reviews your health risks, medications, and screenings and builds a personalized prevention plan. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

### Does VNHL offer bilingual care in Spanish?

Yes. Our bilingual staff assist Spanish-speaking patients with scheduling, consultation, and care planning. Hablamos Español.

### How do I request a prescription refill?

The fastest way is to have your pharmacy send an electronic request to VNHL. You may also call (619) 429-7700.

## Medical Weight Management

### What is medical weight management at VNHL?

Physician-supervised medical weight management with Dr. K combines personalized goals, nutrition and activity guidance, and, when appropriate, prescription therapy including GLP-1 medications.

### Who may benefit, and do I need to have diabetes?

Adults, including seniors, who want sustainable weight loss may benefit. You do not need diabetes. Dr. K reviews your health history, goals, and conditions to decide whether therapy is right for you.

### Are weight management medications safe?

Most patients tolerate GLP-1 medications well. Common side effects include nausea or constipation, and rare risks include slowed stomach emptying or vision changes. Dr. K monitors you closely throughout treatment.

### How do I get started with medical weight management?

Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to schedule a visit. Dr. K will evaluate your specific medical conditions and coordinate the whole process with you to build a Healthy Living Plan Together.

### Does insurance cover weight management therapy?

Coverage depends on your plan and your medical conditions. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

## Medicare and Insurance

### Can I see Dr. K with Original Medicare?

Yes. Dr. K accepts Original Medicare with or without a supplement plan. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

### Which Medicare Advantage plan do you accept?

For Medicare Advantage, Dr. K accepts only Sharp-SCMG Advantage plans. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

## Medicare and Weight Management

### What is the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Program?

It is a temporary CMS program that may help eligible Medicare members, including Medicare Advantage members, access GLP-1 medications for weight management. Eligibility and details are individual, so please call us. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

### Do I qualify for the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Program?

Qualification and authorization depend on several factors. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to schedule a visit. Dr. K will evaluate your specific medical conditions and coordinate the whole process with you to build a Healthy Living Plan Together.

### How does Dr. K connect my Medicare care and weight management?

Your Medicare Annual Wellness Visit is a natural starting point. Dr. K reviews your history, medications, and goals, then coordinates weight management with the rest of your care in one Healthy Living Plan. Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

## Location and Hours

### Where is the clinic and is parking available?

VNHL is at 707 Palm Avenue, Imperial Beach, CA 91932, next to the Hampton Inn & Suites at the corner of Palm Ave and 7th. Ample free, ADA-accessible parking is available.

### Is the clinic handicap accessible?

Yes. VNHL's facility and parking at 707 Palm Avenue, Imperial Beach are fully ADA compliant with accessible parking.

### What are your hours and phone number?

VNHL is open Monday through Thursday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and Friday 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Call (619) 429-7700. Public transit: MTS Bus Routes 933 and 934.
